svg.title: Beyond the code: Baseball: I played all through high school on various travel teams, and I'm a die-hard Atlanta Braves fan. Basketball: My favorite pastime with my friends for as long as I can remember. Travel: As a kid, traveling with my family was how we connected. Now my wife and I travel as much as our schedule allows. Bowling: Humbly part of the 200 club at the BYU bowling alley. I got the score on my first try, and now I'm going for 300. Golf: As a kid I thought golf was boring. Now that I'm older... golf is still boring, but in a relaxing way I enjoy with friends and family. Each hobby plays as an animated pencil sketch.
